generationInputs.prompt: A digitally drawn illustration in a clean, graphic, and expressive modern emoji style shows a happy yellow emoji with bold black outlines and flat, vibrant color fills, facing away from the viewer as if looking in a mirror. The emoji has a round head with two large, expressive brown eyes with white highlights and black pupils looking slightly upward. Thick, curved black eyebrows are raised in a happy expression. A wide, curved black line indicates a smile. The emoji has a small, rounded body with two muscular arms raised outwards and bent at the elbows, with hands open in a cheerful gesture. Below the torso are two muscular legs with feet pointing outwards. A flat black garment, resembling underwear bottoms with bold black outlines, is worn low on the emoji's body. There is subtle shading suggesting a surface below the emoji.
